blocks.text: SB19 and BINI are among the leading contenders at the 11th PPop Music Awards, earning multiple nominations across major categories. Both groups are nominated for Artist of the Year. SB19 received nods for Song of the Year for “VISA” and “Lawless,” while BINI’s “Blush” also vie in the category. Both groups also earned additional nominations in music video production and performance-related categories. P-pop acts G22, KAIA, ALAMAT, and BGYO were also nominated in various categories.
